decision.article_title: 我国部署“十五五”铁路科技创新重点任务 - 新华网
decision.reason: Xinhua confirms Chinese National Railway Administration's broad five-year technology innovation plan, target 30 bases/100 breakthroughs/500 achievements. Without project-specific procurement, new documented acceptance rules or a unique buyer mechanism, broad R&D targets alone do not imply a new no-external-service micro SaaS.
